'''Wim's hoverbike''' was an inexpensive [[hoverbike]] owned by the [[human]] [[Wim]] on the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] during the [[New Republic Era]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Color|teal]] and yellow [[hoverbike]] was an inexpensive recreation speeder owned by the [[human]] [[Wim]]<ref name="DB" /> on the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Real Adventure">{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}}</ref> It was 1.39 [[meter]]s long, 0.64 meters wide, 0.78 meters high and had a storage basket mounted on the rear of the bike.<ref name="DB" />

==History==
Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> after oversleeping and missing the tram for the [[Career Assessment Test]], Wim ran back [[Wim's home|home]] got his bike from the garage. Trying to make it to [[At Attin Middle School Gamma|school]] in time for the test he speed past the [[Ithorian]] Mrs. [[Ikk]] scaring their [[At Attin frogdog|frog-dog]] causing it to bark at him. Wim took his hoverbike through the [[forest]] hoping it would be a shortcut. While racing through the forest on his hoverbike, Wim runs into several branches and shrubs, causing him to drop his helmet. As he rides towards the city center he attempts to slam the breaks to avoid a ravine but loses his balance and falls down into the ravine. In the ravine Wim [[Onyx Cinder|finds]] a hatch which he believes might be a [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] however before he can investigate a [[Safety droid]] finds him and escorts him to school. Later Wim returns to the raving with his friend [[Neel]] and their hoverbikes.<ref name="Real Adventure" />

==Behind the scenes==
The hoverbike first appeared in "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]],"<ref name="Real Adventure" /> the first episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref>
